title: Fix Node adapter reconnect exponential backoff (F8/F18)
description:
## Finding F8/F18 (Council: P1, 95% confidence)

MineflayerAdapter/index.js implements exponential backoff for reconnecting to the Minecraft server: `delay = min(2000 * 2^_reconnectAttempts, 60000)`. However, `_reconnectAttempts = 0` is reset at the START of `connectBot()` (line 315), before the connection attempt. The `bot.on('end')` handler reads `_reconnectAttempts` to compute delay, then calls `connectBot()` which resets to 0. Every reconnect starts at `2000 × 2^0 = 2s`. The documented curve (2→4→8→16→32→60s) never manifests.

## Effect
During any sustained outage, the adapter hammers the Minecraft server with a reconnection attempt every 2 seconds indefinitely. For servers with connection-rate limiting, this risks being throttled or flagged.

## Recommendation
1. Move `_reconnectAttempts = 0` out of `connectBot()` and into the `'spawn'` handler (reset only on confirmed successful connection)
2. Don't log/emit "reconnected successfully" until `'spawn'` actually fires
3. Add a test (or manual verification note) simulating two consecutive failed reconnects and asserting the second delay is longer than the first
